name: Layouts
summary: Free MIT open-source animated React UI layouts and micro-interactions.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of 64 registry items — not a full inventory.
Import paths after CLI follow project aliases; registry example files live under registry/default/example/{slug}.tsx.
Some comps need @hugeicons/react / lucide-react / framer-motion vs motion peers.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: 3D Book

copyPrompt.text: Use useLayouts free component `3D Book` (slug `3d-book`) from https://uselayouts.com/docs/components/3d-book. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @uselayouts/3d-book` (or `npx shadcn@latest add https://uselayouts.com/r/3d-book.json`). Registry item: https://uselayouts.com/r/3d-book.json. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS; peers: motion. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iurvish/uselayouts/main/LICENSE). Pricing free — open-source animated layouts.
